SELECT e.event_id AS eventId,
r.reservation_id AS reservationId, e.title AS eventTitle, r.reservation_date AS reservationDate, r.status AS reservationStatus, r.headcount AS headCount, e.location AS location, p.amount AS paymentAmount, p.status AS paymentStatus, p.method AS paymentMethod FROM reservation r JOIN event e ON r.event_id = e.event_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON r.reservation_id = p.reservation_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.reservation_date desc

SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, e.title AS eventTitle, r.reservation_date AS reservationDate, r.status AS reservationStatus, r.headcount AS headCount, e.location AS location, p.amount AS paymentAmount, p.status AS paymentStatus, p.method AS paymentMethod FROM reservation r JOIN event e ON r.event_id = e.event_id JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON r.reservation_id = p.reservation_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId, e.title AS eventTitle,
u.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName,
r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.reservation_date AS reservationDate, r.status AS reservationStatus, r.headcount AS headCount, e.location AS location, r.user_type AS userType, r.qr_code AS qrCode, r.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, r.cancelled_at AS reservationCancelledAt,
p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.amount AS paymentAmount, p.status AS paymentStatus, p.method AS paymentMethod, p.refund_amount AS refundAmount, p.approve_no AS approveNo, p.pg_tid AS pgTid, p.memo AS memo, p.paid_at AS paidAt, p.cancelled_at AS paymentCancelledAt, p.created_at AS paymentCreatedAt, p.imp_uid AS impUid
FROM reservation r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id JOIN event e ON r.event_id = e.event_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id
ORDER BY r.reservation_date DESC limit #{cri.pageStart},#{cri.perPageNum}
